description: A React component for managing team members in the Mattermost admin console, including listing, filtering, searching, and adding/removing users from a team.

classes.name: TeamMembers
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing team members, including filtering, searching, and role updates.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial data loading when component mounts, fetching team stats and profiles.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to filters or search term, triggering profile reloads or searches.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of team members.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Removes a user from the team.

methods.name: onAddCallback
methods.description: Callback for adding users to the team.

methods.name: onFilter
methods.description: Applies role-based filters to the user list.

methods.name: updateMembership
methods.description: Updates a user's role within the team.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including user grid and add members button.
